reviews.title: Great at first but….
reviews.text:
This seems like a great app and could possibly be revolutionary but $50 subscription is steep and the 3 day trial doesn’t seem long enough for me to play around with the app to see if I want to use it more. I have no idea why but most of the models are small and don’t scale properly when testing some of the models I made were tiny despite making the models bigger in the editor. Once you either get the 3 day trial or a subscription and use all your coins yes your AI coins that’s it you can’t generate anything until your subscription renewal what’s the point of the subscription if I have to have another thing to pay for to keep generating items. This app just seems more like a crash grab than anything else. 

There’s also something’s that thins app doesn’t tell you  one it follows Roblox uploads system were you have to have robux in your account to upload items witch would be nice to know as I didn’t know this. In the end it doesn’t seem like it’s worth the $50 to upload items
Forgot to mention that I order to upload an item you need a minimum of 750 robux for 3D models in your account before uploading which then gos through the verification process if declined won’t give you your 750 robux. This review is just a warning to those that want to use this app and want to use it to make Robux

reviews.title: THIS APP IS TERRIBLE
reviews.text: This app is an absolute nightmare to use and has become a complete waste of time for anyone trying to design and upload shirts on mobile. What should be a creative process is instead a laggy, frustrating experience because the app is insanely slow and the interface is cluttered with an exhausting number of steps just to get a single item ready. Even if you manage to navigate the clunky menus, the mobile upload process is nearly impossible and feels like it was designed to fail, often hitting you with glitches or black screens at the final step. To make matters worse, the greed is unbearable; the app constantly bombards you with a switch-to-premium popup that reappears literally every minute, interrupting your work so often that it’s impossible to focus. It’s clearly prioritized squeezing money out of users over basic functionality, leaving the free version as a broken, sluggish mess that makes you want to delete it within minutes of opening. SHUT DOWN NOW!
